question: Should Crabline retain its Node 22 runtime contract, or intentionally raise the runtime and declaration baseline to Node 26?
rationale: A declarations-only major bump changes which runtime APIs TypeScript accepts without changing the package's supported execution environment, so the permanent baseline requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Retain Node 22
options.body: Keep `@types/node` on 22.x so compile-time APIs remain aligned with the advertised runtime.

options.title: Coordinate Node 26
options.body: Pause this dependency bump until the runtime floor, CI coverage, documentation, and upgrade proof move to Node 26 together.

recommendation.title: Retain Node 22
recommendation.body: Keep `@types/node` on 22.x so compile-time APIs remain aligned with the advertised runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from recent Crabline compatibility and integration work, although direct manifest ownership is not established.
